about: avenDB's performance gates, held by scripts/ci/avendb-bench.mjs to the lines of crates/avendb/tests/bench_gates.rs and crates/avendb-server/tests/relay_bench.rs (the bench job of avendb-checks.yml). A gate missed fails the PR; a target is printed with whether it is met. Gates sit at the level reached on 2026-10-27 with headroom for a shared runner; raise one when the code reaches past it. The carriers' gates sit at under half of the first CI run's (2026-10-27: direct 582 edits/s, relay 710, a 1 MB/s link 93 edits/s at 0.56 of it, 1001 edits of 6 KB); draft_on_ratio_max (1.2) is null until Log::draft_on reads its log's index (claude/s-draft-on). The phone-class rows (WebAssembly in Chromium and WebKit) gate nothing yet.
